item.title: A Harbour Side Cottage in The Heart of Kinlochbervie
item.description: Harbour Cottage in Kinlochbervie offers a three bedroom detached home with harbour views, wraparound garden and potential for additional accommodation, set in one of the most dramatic coastal locations in the northwest Highlands.The post A Harbour Side Cottage in The Heart of Kinlochbervie appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Western Isles Council Urges Rethink on Balivanich Bank Closure
item.description: Comhairle nan Eilean Siar is urging Bank of Scotland to reconsider plans to close its Balivanich branch, warning the move could harm communities across Uist and Benbecula. The post Western Isles Council Urges Rethink on Balivanich Bank Closure appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £2 Bus Fare Cap Set To Cut Travel Costs Across The Highlands
item.description: A £2 capped bus fare pilot is being rolled out across the Highlands and Islands this month, cutting the cost of journeys such as Wick to Inverness and Elgin to Inverness to just £2.The post £2 Bus Fare Cap Set To Cut Travel Costs Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: 40 Years of HIAL Connecting Highlands and Islands Communities
item.description: Highlands and Islands Airports Ltd has marked its 40th anniversary, celebrating four decades of providing vital air connectivity across Scotland’s rural and island communities through its network of regional airports.The post 40 Years of HIAL Connecting Highlands and Islands Communities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Public Invited To Help Shape NHS Highland’s New 10 Year Health Strategy
item.description: NHS Highland has launched public engagement on a new ten year health strategy, inviting people across Highland, Argyll and Bute to share views on how health and social care services should develop.The post Public Invited To Help Shape NHS Highland’s New 10 Year Health Strategy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Miss Hoolie’s Iconic Hair Inspired by 90s Dance Band Deee Lite
item.description: Balamory star Julie Wilson Nimmo has revealed the inspiration behind Miss Hoolie’s iconic hairstyle as the beloved children’s series prepares to return to screens this April.The post Miss Hoolie’s Iconic Hair Inspired by 90s Dance Band Deee Lite appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Energy Efficiency Improvements Welcomed as More Scottish Homes Reach EPC C Rating
item.description: New figures show 62 per cent of homes in Scotland are now rated EPC C or higher for energy efficiency, while fuel poverty levels have fallen compared with the previous year. The post Energy Efficiency Improvements Welcomed as More Scottish Homes Reach EPC C Rating appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ardersier Residents Invited to Share Views on Proposed Development Area
item.description: Ardersier residents are being invited to a second public engagement event on 11 March to discuss a proposed Masterplan Consent Area that could see up to 600 homes developed east of the village.The post Ardersier Residents Invited to Share Views on Proposed Development Area appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: ROV Training Course Returns To Fort William As Subsea Career Path Opens
item.description: A new “Pathway to ROV” training course is launching in Fort William this April, offering hands on subsea training for people looking to begin a career in the offshore industry.The post ROV Training Course Returns To Fort William As Subsea Career Path Opens appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Scalpay Car Park Created to Support Growing Numbers of Island Walkers
item.description: A new public car park has opened on the island of Scalpay after Bakkafrost Scotland supported community efforts to manage rising visitor numbers along the popular Scalpay Heritage Trail.The post New Scalpay Car Park Created to Support Growing Numbers of Island Walkers appeared first on The Highland Times.
